title: Add applyTax and make pricing helpers take (percent, priceCents)

bug.description: applyDiscount's parameters were swapped to (percent, priceCents), but its caller amountToCharge in src/checkout.ts (not changed in this PR) still calls applyDiscount(subtotal, coupon.percent), so the subtotal is used as the percent: it throws a RangeError or charges a wrong amount.
